answer.submission_route: Submit in writing with member name/ID, provider, service date, reason and supporting documents — or file through the My CareSource portal. Online: File a Grievance/Appeal in your My CareSource portal account By mail: CareSource, Attention: Ohio Member Appeals, P.O. Box 1947, Dayton, OH 45401 (Ohio Marketplace; other states/lines differ) By phone: The Member Services number on your ID card Deadline: 180 days of receiving the adverse benefit determination -- but your denial letter is authoritative.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Your plan delegates musculoskeletal surgery to TurningPoint, whose criteria are NOT published. Their own page says to submit the contact form naming your health plan to receive the correct policy. Do that, and put the same request in writing in your appeal - plans must supply the criteria used on request.
answer.notes: no public criteria on file; abstained and routed
